The strategy reacts to opponents' highest bid from yesterday's trace. If opponents bid very high and my HP is good, I bid low to save budget and pressure them. Otherwise, I bid slightly above their highest previous bid, or aggressively if my HP is critical.

My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when my HP is low or opponents' previous bids were high. When my HP is good and competition is moderate, I aim to slightly outbid previous high bids to secure water efficiently, preserving budget.
